name: hud_ui_mgr_ensure_hud_loaded_minimal
description: HudUiMgr::EnsureHudLoaded handles the already-loaded guard and missing-root failure paths.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this large loader remains deferred to a coherent HUD manager/source-cluster tier S pass.

The registered native smoke is compiled from the lifecycle-only zHud test branch, so it currently verifies the already-loaded guard and missing archive-backed root failure paths. The broader minimal archive-backed success smoke remains present in the non-lifecycle branch but is not registered in recoil_native_smoke by the current CMake split.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x410160 validates the already-loaded early return, zReader::LoadNodeFromPath failure return, mission resource initialization, layout switch, optional named-section processing, SetModeCounterState(0, 2), zReader::FreeLoadedTree, SetFloatTimerVisible(0), SetAuxOverlayVisible(0), and setting g_HudUiMgrHudLoaded to 1.
The registered native smoke verifies the already-loaded guard and missing archive-backed root failure without broadening into the non-lifecycle zHud smoke branch.
